import pandas as pd

def read(f):
 d=pd.read_csv(f, comment='#')
 print(d.columns, d.head(2))
 return d
w=read('task1_data_and_tasks/data/wingra.csv'); m=read('task1_data_and_tasks/data/mendota.csv')
for name,d in [('w',w),('m',m)]:
 d.timestamp=pd.to_datetime(d.timestamp)
 x=d[(d.timestamp.dt.date==pd.Timestamp('2026-07-22').date()) & (d.timestamp.dt.hour>=8) | ((d.timestamp.dt.date==pd.Timestamp('2026-07-23').date()) & (d.timestamp.dt.hour<8))]
 # precedence is intended but ensure
 x=d[((d.timestamp>=pd.Timestamp('2026-07-22 08:00'))&(d.timestamp<pd.Timestamp('2026-07-23 08:00')))]
 x=x[x.water_temp_qc==0]
 print(name,len(x),x.water_temp_C.mean(),x[['timestamp','water_temp_C','water_temp_qc']].tail())
